name: PVC-P
bestUses: Flexible hoses, seals and rubber-like parts are the maker's proposed applications (purefil PVC-P: "flexible Schläuche, Dichtungen und Gummiteile").
limitations: Heat deflection does not apply to it. Its maker asks for an enclosed printer with an activated-carbon filter: PVC can decompose in the nozzle if it dwells there too long or runs too hot.
identityNote: A material of its own (the owner's rulings, R233, D176), as ISO 1043 names plasticised PVC apart from the rigid one (PVC-U): a plasticiser lowers PVC's glass transition below room temperature, and the small PVC crystallites then hold the chains as a thermoplastic elastomer's hard blocks do, so a Shore A rated PVC-P is a rubber where rigid PVC is a 2 to 4 GPa glass. purefil's "Polyvinylchlorid weich 94A (PVC-P)" is "ein flexibles 3D-Druckmaterial" with "gummiähnliche Eigenschaften", Shore 94A and 366 % elongation at break. Under Flexible Elastomers, where a reader looks for a rubber. No polymers.csv row (a plasticised compound's figures follow its plasticiser content), so the estimate model cannot place it and it is not estimated. It was a product of PVC (M135) until then, estimated there at 0.2 to 8.7 GPa.

notApplicable.hdt045: HDT is a rigid-bar test. ISO 75 ends at 0.2 % outer-fibre strain, which a bar reaches once its modulus falls to about 225 MPa, so an elastomer has no meaningful HDT and makers list it as N/A. A value an elastomer's sheet publishes is shown and never decides. Sintering filaments are left out too: the finished part is the sintered metal or ceramic.

items.text: It is often used for projects that require flexible and rubber-like properties.
PVC-soft is very flexible and is ideal for applications that require mobility or adaptability, such as flexible hoses, seals and rubber parts.
This material is ideal for prototypes and functional parts that require both flexibility and durability.
The use of high-quality raw materials results in a 3D printer filament that is particularly easy to process.
PVC-soft filament is a flexible 3D printing material that is characterized by its softness and elasticity.
This filament is resistant to many chemicals, making it ideal for use in chemically exposed environments.
PVC-Soft filament has good resistance to wear, which increases the longevity of the printed parts.
can decompose if left in the nozzle for too long or at high temperatures
A state-of-the-art manufacturing process achieves very low manufacturing tolerances, which leads to convincing printing results with all FDM 3D printers.
We recommend processing PVC-P exclusively on closed 3D printers with an integrated activated carbon filter.
It is easy to print and does not necessarily require a heated print bed, which makes it easier to handle.
